tailMarker.note: Parfum @6 is the earliest tail-class species. Sodium Benzoate @9 and Potassium Sorbate @21 follow it, and the allergen Coumarin @18 comes after Parfum, so the class order is consistent and the E2 third limb does not fire. The base (Cetearyl Alcohol @2, Dicaprylyl Ether @3, Coco-Caprylate @4, Behentrimonium Chloride @5) outranks the marker. A second cationic (Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine @12) and Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @10 sit in the tail. They are read as sub-1% secondary species, not as a base the marker precedes. tail_index-1 = Behentrimonium Chloride @5.

conditioning_level.rationale: S2 fires (Cetearyl Alcohol @2). S3 fires (Dicaprylyl Ether @3 and Coco-Caprylate @4, both R4a light emollients). S1 fails, because Behentrimonium Chloride @5 is the only above-tail cationic. S2+S3 without S1 is moderate (R3). BTAC @5 is at the boundary but not load-bearing, since S1 fails either way.
counterSignals: shea butter @10 and coconut oil @14 are tail (no credit)

weight_potential.rationale: High is unavailable: no R4b lipid sits above Parfum @6 (Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @10 and Cocos Nucifera Oil @14 are tail). Low fails conjunct 3 (E7 full list), because two distinct cationic species are declared: Behentrimonium Chloride @5 and Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine @12. The guar @16 is a polymer and is not counted. The value hinges on BTAC @5 at tail_index-1 in the §9.2 'single-cationic count' sense, so the boundary note fires and confidence is capped at moderate.
counterSignals: the leanness test fails only on a second cationic at @12 in the tail

care_direction.rationale: No R5 species appears anywhere on the list. The care result comes from a coherent fatty-alcohol/quat/light-ester emollient base, which is the moisture default. Reading (b) does not apply: there is no R2, R3 or R6a species above the tail, and an R4 stack is present. Every humectant (Glycerin @7, Panthenol @8, Propylene Glycol @11) is in the tail. Confidence is held at moderate rather than high because the marker plausibility rests on reading the tail cationic and butter as secondary.

repair_support_level.rationale: No protein, peptide or bond token appears, so only ordinary conditioning and lubrication remain. Niacinamide @17 is a zero-credit vitamin token.
